main-zoom.description: The ONLY IPC this app grants. The tutor's window loads a remote origin (http://localhost:<port>, not tauri://), so page scripts reach Rust only through what is listed here — and what is listed here is one command taking one float. ZOOM_JS in main.rs reads the wheel/pinch/keyboard gestures that Rust cannot see, and calls this to apply them as real webview zoom; doing it in CSS instead is what threw every portaled dropdown and dialog off screen at any zoom above 1. The port is picked at boot by firstrun::pick_app_ports and cannot be known here, so the port is a wildcard; the origin is not. Verified against the urlpattern 0.3.0 that Tauri resolves remote.urls with: this matches http://localhost:<any port>/<any path> and refuses a foreign origin.
